payload.body: Two small things to sign, on cc/ST0003 (06d9b16 and 59a957c over main's WP03). (1) Texts from vc's note 3. switch::none_message for use --none: No login is in the shared config now: every login is back in its own profile, as an older ccusage expects, and Claude started from a GUI app reads NAME's. Without an active profile it ends after expects. shared::point_launchd's new error when launchctl cannot set the variable: launchctl could not set CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR, so Claude started from a GUI app has no login until the next ccusage use; see ccusage doctor. (2) The shape of todo 3b, as you asked. Each usage report, and so usage --json, carries subscription_type and rate_limit_tier at its top level, exactly as the login records them, and null when the login was not read or records none. Inside, Report has plan: usage::Plan, flattened. Its run is next.
